summary:
Cover Brief Review — Coastline Quarterly Summer 2026 Issue

AUTO-GENERATED SUMMARY (recording authority)

Attendees: Mia Lee (illustrator), Rosa Santos (art director, Coastline Quarterly)

Agreed Scope:
1. Mia to deliver two initial sketch concepts (full-bleed cover compositions) — DEADLINE: 2026-06-10, EOD Pacific
2. Rosa to send updated brand color palette PDF (revised coastal teal + warm sand tones replacing the previous slate-blue spec) — DEADLINE: 2026-06-05, EOD Eastern
3. Mia to incorporate approved palette into final illustration pass after sketch sign-off — no secondary color exploration needed unless Rosa flags an issue after step 2
4. Final illustration delivery (print-ready, 300 dpi, CMYK, bleed marks) — DEADLINE: 2026-06-25
5. Rosa to confirm masthead overlay clearance zone dimensions and send updated cover template — DEADLINE: 2026-06-05, same send as palette
6. Licensing: one-time print + digital editorial rights for Summer 2026 issue only; no derivative or promotional use without separate agreement
7. Kill fee: 30% of project fee if cancelled after sketch approval

Fee confirmed: $2,400 flat. Invoice to be sent by Mia after sketch approval (approx. 2026-06-12).

Discussion notes:
- Rosa mentioned the previous cover artist used slate-blue as the dominant hue; the editorial board voted to pivot to the coastal teal + warm sand palette for the summer refresh. This revision request was explicitly flagged as non-negotiable.
- Mia asked about spine bleed — Rosa confirmed full-bleed to all four edges required, spine text handled by CQ design team.
- Both parties confirmed email (r.santos@coastlinequarterly.example / mia@mialeeillustation.example) as primary communication channel for deliverables.
